rungs: L0 assumed/read, L1 simulated, L2 replayed real footage, L3 emulator/mock device, L4 real device+glasses, L5 supervised BLV users

G1.title: Clean checkout builds and passes unit tests via init.sh
G1.evidence: init.sh: R5 baseline, 85 core tests, G6 regression tripwire (2026-11-12, after review fixes)

G2.title: App runs end to end in emulator on replayed and synthetic scenes; cues produced, spoken, logged
G2.evidence: Android SDK/emulator not installed by user decision (ADR 0003); Android adapters not yet written. See G2a

G2a.title: Full pipeline runs end to end on the desktop JVM with a mock frame source on synthetic scenes and replayed logs; cues produced, rendered by a logging audio sink, logged (ADR 0003; evidence labelled L3-substitute)
G2a.evidence: docs/results/demo_cue_log.md: end-to-end desktop run with a synthetic frame source and logging audio sink. Replaying the saved event log shows determinism only. Not emulator evidence

G3.title: Per-stage timestamps; latency report p50/p95/p99 vs budget, pass/fail per cue type
G3.evidence: Mechanism exists (per-stage stamps, docs/results/latency_report.md) but hardware stages are drawn from the assumed budget, so the report cannot fail on them; only core compute (0.02 ms p95, desktop) is measured. Real numbers need phone and glasses

G4.title: Safety path survives loss of network, camera, Bluetooth, slow cloud; distinct degraded cue within stated time
G4.evidence: HealthTest (12) + ReviewRegressionTest: camera loss cue <=0.6 s from last usable frame (<=1.25 s if a Stop is playing); phone-clock only; frames >1 s old unusable; BT loss on phone <=1 s. L1. Silent cases remain: dead detector, covered lens, killed app

G5.title: Navigation on replayed GPS trace A to B with Maps (or recorded responses); predicted-time turn rule
G5.evidence: NavigatorTest (8): SYNTHETIC Directions-format route (no key; live API path unverified), replayed 1 Hz GPS. Predicted-time rule fires several seconds before the corner; wording is "at the next corner", never "now". Crossing detection depends on route text. L1

G6.title: Hazard evaluation on scene set shared with baseline; miss and false-alarm rates vs R5 (2.0% FA, 47.4% miss)
G6.evidence: docs/results/g6_baseline_comparison.md. NOT like-for-like: method is given depth from true distance. Matched threshold: 1.30% FA / 11.33% miss with pitch given; 2.29% / 19.60% with pitch unknown (worse than R5 on FA). Deployed setting: 15.9-27.0% FA, 0.9-2.4% miss. R5: 2.00 / 47.39. L1

G7.title: Cloud tier off the critical path; hallucination guard tested
G7.evidence: CloudGuardTest (21) + ReviewRegressionTest: crossing always refused, forward never spoken, topic word-list filter, guard cannot throw; reviewer's 24 paraphrases silent. Residual: a word list can be evaded

G8.title: Cue priority, arbitration, repetition control tested incl. stop/back off/approach again
G8.evidence: ArbiterTest (5), ScenarioTest, scenario_rates.md: S-07 and S-08 correct in 299/300; dropped hazard cues are re-requested. False-STOP rates are high (9.7-13% on three quiet scenes)

G9.title: Safety case, ADRs, research notes, hardware checklist committed; adversarial review done
G9.evidence: Safety case v2, ADRs 0001-0007, research notes, adversarial review and response committed. Hardware checklist and final report are P6
